PPAC Journal

August 2026 | Edition VI

Introducing the 6th Edition of the PPAC Journal, themed “Reimagining Mobility: Future Transportation Fuels for Viksit Bharat 2047”, featuring insights on multi-fuel pathways, emerging technologies and sustainable infrastructure shaping India’s transition towards a cleaner, resilient and future-ready mobility ecosystem.

View Report (Pdf, 41 MB)

(PPAC Journal)

Key Areas

  • Multi-Fuel Mobility Pathways for Viksit Bharat 2047

  • Electrification and Emerging Vehicle Technologies

  • Biofuels, CBG, Natural Gas, Hydrogen, SAF and E-Fuels

  • Decarbonisation of Road, Rail, Aviation and Maritime Transport

  • Future-Ready Mobility Infrastructure and Multi-Energy Retailing

  • Policy, Regulatory Frameworks and Global Best Practices

Oil & Gas Snapshot of States

Volume : 2026-27 Edition : I

The publication is in snapshot format where Oil & Gas key indicators are available for each State/UT. It also includes critical demographic and economic parameters like population (projected), per capita income, GSDP etc.
